recorder.capture_method: Output restituiti da exec_command e write_stdin nella conversazione; nessun recorder su file o redirezione stdout.
recorder.raw_stdout_provenance: Trascrizione degli output integrali dei tre run completati, già restituiti dai tool nella conversazione.
recorder.stream_limitation: I tool restituiscono un campo output aggregato. Nei run completati contiene le righe di risultato riportate come stdout; stderr non è stato acquisito separatamente.

exact_commands.attempt_1:
sbcl --noinform --no-userinit --no-sysinit --script /dev/stdin <<'LISP'
(require :asdf)
(setf asdf:*compile-file-failure-behaviour* :error
      asdf:*compile-file-warnings-behaviour* :error)
(handler-bind ((warning (lambda (condition) (error "Avviso non ammesso: ~A" condition))))
  (asdf:load-asd (truename "arcdocdb.asd"))
  (asdf:load-system "arcdocdb")
  (load "tests/foundation/support.lisp")
  (load "tests/io/support.lisp")
  (load "tests/series/support.lisp")
  (dolist (source '("tests/series/controller.lisp" "tests/series/threads.lisp"))
    (let ((output (merge-pathnames
                   (format nil "series-bootstrap-~A-~D.fasl" (pathname-name source) (sb-posix:getpid))
                   (uiop:temporary-directory))))
      (unwind-protect
           (multiple-value-bind (compiled warnings failure) (compile-file source :output-file output)
             (when (or warnings failure) (error "Compilazione non pulita: ~A" source))
             (load compiled))
        (when (probe-file output) (delete-file output)))))
  (uiop:symbol-call :arcdocdb.series.tests :run))
LISP

exact_commands.successful_runs:
sbcl --noinform --no-userinit --no-sysinit --script /dev/stdin <<'LISP'
(require :asdf)
(require :sb-posix)
(setf asdf:*compile-file-failure-behaviour* :error
      asdf:*compile-file-warnings-behaviour* :error)
(handler-bind ((warning (lambda (condition)
                          (unless (typep condition 'sb-kernel:redefinition-warning)
                            (error "Avviso non ammesso: ~A" condition)))))
  (asdf:load-asd (truename "arcdocdb.asd"))
  (asdf:load-system "arcdocdb")
  (load "tests/foundation/support.lisp")
  (load "tests/io/support.lisp")
  (load "tests/series/support.lisp")
  (dolist (source '("tests/series/controller.lisp" "tests/series/threads.lisp"))
    (let ((output (merge-pathnames
                   (format nil "series-bootstrap-~A-~D.fasl" (pathname-name source) (sb-posix:getpid))
                   (uiop:temporary-directory))))
      (unwind-protect
           (multiple-value-bind (compiled warnings failure) (compile-file source :output-file output)
             (when (or warnings failure) (error "Compilazione non pulita: ~A" source))
             (load compiled))
        (when (probe-file output) (delete-file output)))))
  (uiop:symbol-call :arcdocdb.series.tests :run))

execution_environment.implementation_loading: asdf:load-system "arcdocdb", senza :force; ASDF può riusare la propria cache.
execution_environment.test_compilation: compile-file dei soli due file autorizzati; warnings/failure causano errore.
execution_environment.warning_policy_in_successful_command: WARNING causa errore, esclusi sb-kernel:redefinition-warning come nello script build esistente.
execution_environment.temporary_fasl_cleanup: delete-file in unwind-protect, come riportato nel comando; nessun controllo aggiuntivo successivo.

before.note: Nessun manifest/hash pre-run o snapshot immutabile acquisito.

after.note: Nessun manifest/hash post-run acquisito; non si effettuano ora ulteriori verifiche.

source_immutability.observed_context: Durante il lavoro sono state osservate modifiche concorrenti nei sorgenti condivisi, incluse le revisioni del bootstrap e l'estrazione in %check-initial-root.
source_immutability.conclusion: Immutabilità prima/dopo NON ATTESTABILE. I sorgenti letti/caricati non erano congelati.
source_immutability.assertions_inside_tests: I confronti di stato controller/WAL/CSN nei test sono oracoli runtime delle fixture; non costituiscono una verifica di immutabilità dei sorgenti.
